paper_title: VideoLLaMB Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory   Bridges
caption: Length extrapolation results on EgoSchema dataset.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy of different methods, expressed as a percentage, over a range of number of frames. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Frames,” utilizes a linear scale with values ranging from 10 to 60, marked with intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, also employs a linear scale, extending from approximately 42% to 54%, with tick intervals of 2%. A blue solid line represents the accuracy of “Ours (Dynamic Seg)”, beginning at approximately 48% at frame 10 and decreasing to approximately 42% at frame 60. A green solid line shows the accuracy of “Ours (Static 4-Seg)”, starting at approximately 46% at frame 10 and ending at approximately 52% at frame 60.  A orange dashed line depicts the accuracy of “PLLA VA (DP 8)”, beginning at approximately 44% at frame 10 and decreasing to approximately 43% at frame 60, and finally a red dashed line shows the accuracy of “PLLA VA (DP 16)”, beginning at approximately 42% at frame 10 and decreasing to approximately 40% at frame 60.
